svg.aria-label: wireframe schematic — the app’s own layout, drawn frame by frame: the given, then each beat. given a requirement whose beats were harvested with their layout skeletons; beat 1: its schematic derives → it is drawn from the app's own measured layout — the page's real structure at the viewport it was measured in, with the focused element's own text where a beat ringed one; beat 2: no layout was ever harvested for it → it falls back to the archetype drawing, or to the labelled beats under an honest "no schematic drawn yet" — never a guessed picture; beat 3: the requirement's text moves past the drawing → the storyline says so with its stale banner and renders the drawing quiet — there is no per-cell "drawn from the app's measured layout" caption *(removed 2026-09-02, the human: "avoid useless things"; the ⋯ menu's "the schematic doesn't match my app" prompt is still the R15-pattern escape, and it still carries the drawing's provenance into the prompt)*; beat 4: the harvest's geometry moves past the drawing → the same stale banner says the layout moved, and the proof gate refuses the drawing until it is redrawn — a mirror that has stopped matching what the run measured is never shown as current
